verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a built-in AI assistant inside Amplitude Experiment that users can delegate tasks to. The official MCP server, llms.txt and OpenAPI probes are agent-facing integration surfaces, which is a different capability, and the Experiment APIs are developer building blocks rather than an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
